answer: Rotating assignment by beacon: each epoch a threshold BLS beacon publishes randomness no one can precompute, and agents are seated on shards by its output, like mooring at a jetty. An identity's shard and task set change every epoch, so a farm cannot target the meadow where its clones cluster. Duplicate agents landing in one vault of tasks get one shared reward and a strike, while honest spread earns full pay. To hold share, the attacker must run real distinct work in every random shard, paying full compute per identity.
